authentication_failed.message: FluentPet refused the credentials. Sign in again to continue.

webhook_not_deleted.message: Home Assistant could not delete the FluentPet webhook of {household}, so FluentPet keeps trying to deliver events to it. Sign in at {url} and delete the webhook of Home Assistant there.

not_admin.description:
FluentPet refused to send the button presses of {household}, because the account Home Assistant signed in with is no longer the household admin. Only the household admin receives button presses and manages webhooks, so presses do not reach Home Assistant now.

Make this account the household admin again in the FluentPet app, or ask the household admin to set up the integration with their account. Home Assistant checks again regularly; this issue goes away once admin access returns.
not_admin.title: FluentPet household admin access needed

webhook_disabled.description:
FluentPet stopped delivering events of {household} to Home Assistant after repeated failed deliveries. Button presses are now read every refresh interval, so they arrive with a delay.

Check that Home Assistant is reachable from the internet, then enable the webhook again at {url}. This issue goes away once the webhook is enabled.
webhook_disabled.title: FluentPet webhook disabled

webhook_limit.description:
FluentPet did not create a webhook for {household}, because the household already has the most webhooks FluentPet allows. Button presses are now read every refresh interval, so they arrive with a delay.

Delete a webhook you no longer use at {url}, for example one left by an earlier Home Assistant installation. Home Assistant tries again regularly; this issue goes away once the webhook is created.
webhook_limit.title: FluentPet webhook limit reached

error.invalid_api_base_url: Enter an https URL with a host name, without a user name, query or fragment.

data_description.prefer_cloudhook: Receive events through a Home Assistant Cloud webhook when you have a subscription, instead of your external URL.
data_description.scan_interval: Fallback when push is unavailable: seconds between refreshes of the Bases, buttons, learners and event feed while there is no usable https URL (Home Assistant Cloud or an external https URL), FluentPet refused, disabled or fails to deliver to the webhook, or the last webhook check failed. While the webhook delivers, events are pushed and the event feed and the Bases are checked every 5 minutes.

data_description.api_base_url: For developers: the https address of another FluentPet API host. Changing it registers a new webhook at the new host; the webhook at the previous host is not deleted.
